purpose: Replace opaque square R16 nail patches with twenty short rounded/oval conformal natural nails without changing the primary body mesh, identity, rig, or weights.

r16_failure_diagnosis.observed_defect: The safe fallback nails retained visibly square, opaque plate silhouettes.
r16_failure_diagnosis.why_v3_differs: V3 applies the rounded width profile before each body-surface raycast. It does not pull an already fitted rectangular grid across curved skin, which was the intersection mechanism in the two R16 rounding attempts.

implementation.construction: rounded footprint first, then body-surface raycast, bounded outward normal lift, exact terminal-bone rigid binding, outward-only thin plate thickness

materials.free_edge: one distal face-row band, softly paler and translucent

input_contract.body: already-built exact primary MakeHuman adult body mesh
input_contract.armature: already-built exact official rig with all finger and toe terminal bones

hard_gates: exact bilateral inventory of digits 1 through 5 on both hands and feet
ordinary bounded length, width, and aspect ratio
rounded proximal cuticle and rounded short distal edge
zero primary-body triangle overlap at construction
exact terminal bone vertex group with unit weight on every nail vertex
exact armature parent and exact armature-modifier target
primary body mesh hash, rig hash, and body modifier count unchanged

required_pose_rechecks: left and right hand close review
left and right foot close review
integration_contract.repair_scope: If one nail fails, repair or replace only the nail component and preserve the body, face, anatomy, skin, rig, weights, eyes, brows, and detachable hair assets.

rollback.component_rollback: Remove only the twenty V3 nail objects and their two unused V3 materials; the primary body and rig are hash-guarded unchanged.
